title: Caymus Friendsgiving
seo_title: Caymus Friendsgiving Wine Dinner in Ozark, MO
description: Caymus Friendsgiving is a Thanksgiving-style wine dinner where guests enjoy a prepared meal paired with Caymus wines, with no shopping, cooking, or cleanup. It takes place Thursday, November 19, 2026 at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO, with happy hour at 6 PM and dinner at 7 PM. Tickets are $150 ($125 for Cellar Society), and reservations are required by phone at (417) 882-0399 or online.
